instruction.text: Its or it’s? Fill in the gap with the correct word.
instruction.sound: Its, or, it’s? Fill in the gap with the correct word.

hint.text:
Its: shows that something belongs to it.
It’s: it is or it has.
hint.sound: ssml: <prosody rate ='80%'>Its</prosody> without an apostrophe<break time='300ms'/> shows that something <prosody rate ='90%'>belongs</prosody> to it.<break time='500ms'/> <prosody rate ='80%'>It’s</prosody> with an apostrophe<break time='300ms'/> can be short for <prosody rate ='80%'>it is</prosody> or it has.

atoms.a: The cat is washing its paws.
atoms.b: The cat is washing ((++its it’s)) paws.

atoms.a: It’s difficult to play the piano really well.
atoms.b: ((Its ++It’s)) difficult to play the piano really well.

atoms.a: A snail carries its house on its back.
atoms.b: A snail carries ((++its it’s)) house on ((++its it’s)) back.

atoms.a: This is a tadpole. It’s a young frog. Can you see its tiny legs?
atoms.b: This is a tadpole. ((Its ++It’s)) a young frog. Can you see ((++its it’s)) tiny legs?
